h1: Custom Cotton Poly Aprons for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Cotton Poly Aprons | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly aprons for your team or event. Durable, comfortable fabric with full-color imprint. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Cotton poly aprons combine the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them a smart choice for restaurants, trade shows, and hospitality teams. The fabric resists wrinkles and holds up to repeated washing, so your logo stays crisp event after event. Whether you need aprons for a coffee shop or a corporate giveaway, this blend offers comfort and longevity that pure cotton or synthetic options can't match. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished look.
heroAltText: Custom cotton poly aprons with embroidered logo on medium length apron with pouch
